parsed.why: Trans-specific criminal statute penalising feminine presentation (up to six years), documented arrests, forced anal examinations, police raids, rising capital violence, no recognition and state attempts to ban gatherings; courts limit the morality article but the expression offence stands.

Sodomy law struck down and upheld; no trans-specific offence, gender identity named in 2024 harassment law and many SOGI pledges; the immigration 'homosexual' clause survives but is not shown enforced against entrants. Only moderate acceptance; limited visitor-specific evidence.

Thin record: sodomy provisions unenforced with no prosecutions, but no SOGI protections, no visitor-facing data, and only a decade-old 'no discrimination' observation. A recognised traditional gender role is a real cultural positive, but formal recourse is absent — a step down.

No criminalisation, functioning (if gatekept) document-change regime, employment and media protections, acceptance rising to 70%; but martial-law border stops of male-marker holders, hate-crime law omitting gender identity, and dated police inaction on anti-LGBT violence.

Active section 377 enforcement, organized state targeting: police detention, stripping, beating, sexual violence and extortion of trans women, killings in military areas, post-coup intensification. Near 'do not visit' tier.
